קז.ja: כאן וכידא ילזמנא אלאעתבאר בהא, אלא אן אקרבהא מנא ואוצ'חהא ענדנא את'ר אלחכמה אלט'אהר פי נוע אלאנסאן אלד'י הו אלעאלם אלצגיר, והו אלסבב אלקריב לכון הד'א אלעאלם,
קז.en: Thus too it is incumbent upon us to reflect upon them; yet the nearest of them to us and the clearest in our estimation is the trace of the manifest wisdom in the human species, which is the small world, and which is the proximate cause of the being of this world.

pairs.en: it is incumbent upon us to reflect upon them
the nearest of them to us

קז.ja: פקד ילזמנא אלנט'ר פי אוליהֵ אלאנסאן ונשאתה ותאליף אג'זאיה ותרכיב אעצ'איה ומנפעתה בכל ואחד מנהא, ואלצ'רורה אלדאעיה אלי וצ'עה ותשכילה עלי מא הו עליה.
קז.en: So it is incumbent upon us to consider the beginning of the human being and his coming-into-being, the composition of his parts and the structuring of his limbs, and his benefit from each one of them, and the necessity that calls for his being set and shaped as he is.

pairs.en: So it is incumbent upon us to consider
the beginning of the human being
and his coming-into-being
the composition of his parts

קז.ja: ת'ם ננט'ר פי מצאלחה פי כל כ'לק מן אכ'לאקה וקוי נפסה ונור עקלה וג'ואהרה ואעראצ'ה ואמאלה ואנתהא אמרה,
קז.en: Then we consider his interests in every one of his traits of character, the powers of his soul, the light of his intellect, his substances and his accidents, his hopes, and the end of his affair,

pairs.en: Then we consider his interests

and the end of his affair

קז.ja: פאנא אד'א וקפנא עלי מא ד'כרנא מן אלאנסאן תביין לנא מן סר הד'א אלעאלם כת'יר אד' הו שביה בה.
קז.en: For when we have come to understand what we have mentioned concerning the human being, much of the secret of this world will become clear to us, since he resembles it.

pairs.en: For when we have come to understand
what we have mentioned concerning the human being
will become clear to us
much of the secret of this world
since he resembles it

קז.ja: וקד קאל בעץ' אלחכמא אן אלפלספה מערפהֵ אלאנסאן נפסה, אראד בד'לך עלם מא ד'כרנא מן אמר אלאנסאן, פימיז אלכ'אלק ג'ל ועז מן את'ר אלחכמה פיה, כקול איוב ומבשרי אחזה אלוה.
קז.en: One of the sages has said that philosophy is a person's knowledge of himself; by this he meant the knowledge of what we have mentioned concerning the matter of the human being, so that he may distinguish the Creator (mighty and exalted) through the trace of wisdom within him, as Job said: "And from my flesh I shall behold God" (Job 19:26).

pairs.en: One of the sages has said
that philosophy is a person's knowledge of himself
by this he meant

קז.ja: פינבגי לנא אן כאן ד'לך כד'לך אן נד'כר מן ג'מיע מא וצפנא מן אמור אלאנסאן יסירא מן כל מעני, ינבה אלגאפל אלי מא ילזמה אלתד'כר לה דאימא, ויבעת'ה עלי טלב מא לם אד'כר,
קז.en: Since that is so, it behooves us to mention, out of all that we have described of the affairs of the human being, a little of every topic — something that will alert the heedless one to what he is obliged to keep ever in remembrance, and that will rouse him to seek out what I have not mentioned,

pairs.en: it behooves us
Since that is so
to mention

קז.ja: פיכ'צ'ע לכ'אלקה מן אג'ל עט'ים אמתנאנה עליה ואחסאנה אליה, ויעט'ם שכרה לה,
קז.en: so that he may humble himself before his Creator on account of the greatness of His bounty toward him and His beneficence to him, and may magnify his thanks to Him,

קז.ja: כמא קאל אלולי ע"ס אודך על כי נוראות נפליתי נפלאים מעשיך ונפשי ידעת מאד, לא נכחד עצמי ממך אשר עשיתי בסתר רקמתי בתחתיות ארץ, גלמי ראו עיניך ועל ספרך כלם יכתבו ימים יצרו ולא אחד בהם.
קז.en: as the saintly one (peace be upon him) said: "I will give thanks to You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; wonderful are Your works, and my soul knows it well. My frame was not hidden from You, when I was made in secret, intricately wrought in the depths of the earth. Your eyes saw my unformed substance, and in Your book they were all written — the days that were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them" (Psalms 139:14–16).
